title: Nothing Unnecessary
lede: At Layers, good food starts with intention.
lead: We begin with whole ingredients and think carefully about what each one contributes, from flavor and texture to natural sweetness, fiber, nourishment, and function.
body:
We use frozen fruit instead of ice, avoid added water, do not rely on refined sugar or syrups, and develop our bowl bases in house so we have greater control over ingredients, flavor, and texture.

Every recipe is tested and refined through real daily experience, including feedback from our team and customers.
closing_line: Real ingredients. Intentional recipes. Nothing unnecessary.
